text:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing X + LinkedIn schedule for next week's launch & webinar follow-ups. Need assets, CTAs, and engagement handoff. Plan: X thread (5 tweets), single announcement X, two LinkedIn posts (announcement + recap). Who can own scheduling and the carousel images?

Liam: I can own the X thread cadence and tracking UTMs. Suggest posting main X announcement Tue 09:00 PT, thread at 09:10 PT (one tweet every 3m). UTMs: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2. Confirm? :small_blue_diamond:

Cam: I’ll finish the 3-card carousel and 1:1 thumbnail today. Need final headline and product screenshot with 1200x628. Draft captions in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-social-asset-list (please comment).

Sophia: For LinkedIn, do announcement Tue 11:00 ET and recap Thur 10:00 ET. Tone: product-first, short case stat + CTA to webinar recording. I can write two caption variants (formal/short).

Noah: For engagement routing — we should capture inbound DMs and comments for 48h then route to #sales-inbound and tag SDR on high-intent replies. Also add a short form for lead capture on the webinar landing page so we can attach lead tags. Who can update the landing page with the UTM mapping?

Liam: @Noah I’ll update landing page query mapping today. Also proposing a reply playbook for X comments: 1) quick thank you + link to webinar, 2) ask if they want a demo, 3) escalate to SDR if they reply with >50% buying signals. I’ll draft in the thread.

Cam: Assets checklist: hero screenshot (PNG), 3 carousel frames (PNG), 1:1 thumbnail (JPEG), short GIF of latency graph (mp4/gif). I’ll upload to the Notion page and Google Drive folder. Need logo on frame 1 and a small CTA badge on frame 3.

Maya: Approving times from a product-launch POV. Two asks: (1) provide 3 caption variants for X (ann: short, detailed, alt headline) and (2) an X thread outline with lead magnets inline (e.g., webinar CTA + short benchmark nugget).

Sophia: Got it — caption variants incoming by EOD. Also recommend a pinned comment for X with webinar signup link and a follow-up pinned LinkedIn comment with the recording after the event.

Liam: Draft X thread outline (5 tweets):
- Tweet 1: Hook + 1-sentence intro to the launch
- Tweet 2: One benchmark stat + short chart (image)
- Tweet 3: Feature highlight + short quote from beta customer
- Tweet 4: CTA to webinar + signup link (UTM)
- Tweet 5: Quick TL;DR + thread recap + link to blog deep-dive
I’ll add copy suggestions in Notion.

Maya: Who can QA the final copy for compliance and tone? We need to avoid absolute performance claims.

Sophia: I’ll QA for tone, @Legal is on standby for compliance review — tagging them via the compliance checklist.

Noah: Scheduler note: timezone check — posting times above are fine across NA/EMEA. If we want APAC coverage, schedule a boosted LinkedIn post Wed 09:00 SGT.

Cam: Upload ETA: hero + carousel by 16:00 PT, GIF by 18:00 PT. Will add export presets: PNG 1200x628, 1080x1080 for carousels.

Maya: Great. Last piece: engagement follow-ups — can we automate an initial DM for anyone who signs up via the webinar form? Suggested: immediate thank-you DM + link to recording and request for scheduling a quick demo. @Liam can you wire that with the CRM?

Liam: Yep, I’ll set an automatic webhook to send the DM (templated) and create a lead in Salesforce with tag "launch_q2_social". Will return the webhook URL and test results here.

SchedulerBot: Post scheduled: X announcement Tue 09:00 PT (1891310400), X thread starting 09:10 PT (1891310460), LinkedIn announcement Tue 12:00 ET (1891317600), LinkedIn recap Thu 10:00 ET (1891483200).

Maya: Perfect — marking this thread as final plan. If no blockers, Cam + Liam + Sophia deliver assets/copy by EOD today and we go live with scheduling tomorrow. :rocket:

Liam: Quick add — please include a short A/B caption test for X announcement (CTA A: webinar signup; CTA B: demo request). We’ll measure CTR and MQLs.

Cam: Noted. Uploading A/B image variants now.

Sophia: I’ll prepare the A/B copy split.

Maya: Thanks everyone — I’ll circle back after first 24h with engagement numbers and any adjustments for the recap post.
